items.item_text: 01. I understand that I am applying to a position that is 100% Categorically funded. I understand that this means this position is for a limited term as described in the position summary. When the funding ends, the District may eliminate these positions due to the lack of funding. If that happens, the District will provide notices to all affected employees explaining their rights under the Board Policy, Collective Bargaining Agreement, and Education Code. Please also see the Frequently Asked Questions regarding this process. (https://losrios-staging.ingeniuxondemand.com/community/jobs-at-los-rios/job-application-resources/covid-19-recovery-block-grant-positions) Options: Yes | No
Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
Have two (2) years of formal training, internship, or leadership experience reasonably related to the administrator’s administrative assignment.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
